# HolidayMaximizer

HolidayMaximizer.com is an annual-leave planning tool operated by Kattegat Studio (Denmark). It helps users combine annual leave, weekends and public holidays to identify efficient breaks.

## Languages
- English: https://holidaymaximizer.com/
- French: https://holidaymaximizer.com/fr/

## Key pages
- Planner: https://holidaymaximizer.com/
- Countries: https://holidaymaximizer.com/countries/
- Compare countries: https://holidaymaximizer.com/compare/
- Global ranking: https://holidaymaximizer.com/ranking/
- Methodology: https://holidaymaximizer.com/how-it-works/
- Sources and data: https://holidaymaximizer.com/sources/
- Privacy: https://holidaymaximizer.com/privacy/
- Legal/business information: https://holidaymaximizer.com/legal/

Country employment-law context is only described as verified when an official or authoritative source is cited. Public-holiday dates and leave entitlements can change and should be confirmed before booking.

Annual leave ranking: 65 verified country guides, each with an official source and a comparable five-day-week equivalent. Service-length controls adjust tenure-sensitive systems.
